scopeLabel: All nine admitted main-paper pages were actually read as text and images. SI and cited upstream procedures are not admitted or imported. Unreported settings and exact physical batch joins remain unknown.

bindings.caption: Compare OA, EDA and iodide across four diameters. Figure 6 covers 3.3,4.2,5.8 and 8.2 nm NCs with OA, EDA and iodide. Other ligands are not asserted to have been measured at all four sizes. Normalized conductivity uses the corresponding OA value as denominator. Qualified action illustration; no unreported apparatus dimensions, atmosphere, time, measured atomic geometry or experimental trace is implied.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation
